vectors.name: mx.roundtrip.check
vectors.note: MxAddress.convert(make(x)) == x for the A identity: '1' if true

vectors.name: rpc.request
vectors.note: type 0, id, method, 2 replyTo, JSON payload

vectors.name: rpc.error
vectors.note: type 2, payload = MiniString bytes of the message

vectors.name: msg.maximamessage
vectors.note: random(filler 32/1), from A, to B, time 1725000000000, app rpc, data = rpc.request

vectors.name: msg.signature
vectors.note: A's PKCS#1 v1.5 signature over msg.maximamessage (deterministic)

vectors.name: msg.secret
vectors.note: aeskey wrapped to B (randomised padding: verify by decrypting with B's key)

vectors.name: msg.cryptopackage
vectors.note: iv | secret | data (secret is randomised; parse + decrypt)

vectors.name: msg.mined.header
vectors.note: a MINED header (its SHA3 meets MIN_TXPOW_VAL)

vectors.name: mailbox.ack.signature.0
vectors.note: host key signature over the canonical

vectors.name: mailbox.ack.signature.7
vectors.note: host key signature over the canonical

vectors.name: mailbox.probe.frame
vectors.note: the relay's CTRL type 40 possession probe for the host key, seq 0

vectors.name: greeting.device
vectors.note: commsOnly("1.0.48", "", 0): host omitted, topBlock -1, no chain

vectors.name: greeting.relay.sample
vectors.note: a relay greeting with host, cap 512, pool, conns 3, 2 peers

vectors.name: ctrl.id.frame
vectors.note: CTRL TYPE_ID carrying the host key DER (162 bytes, raw)

vectors.name: ctrl.mls.frame
vectors.note: CTRL TYPE_MLS carrying a bare Mx string (UTF-8, no @host)

vectors.name: mls.getreq
vectors.note: GET for B's key with nonce 0xAABBCCDD
